cohort: 4965 women who delivered at DHQ Battagram KPK and United Medical and Dental Collage Karachi, Pakistan between September 2023 and February 2024, of whom 263 (5.29%) had HDP.
finding: Several factors, including older age, rural residence, primigravida status, nulliparity, history of abortion, twin pregnancy, inadequate antenatal care, pre-existing or family history of hypertension, and history of diabetes mellitus, were associated with increased risk of hypertensive disorders during pregnancy.
